title: Workspace where each package reports to its own platform
description: first-package declares "recorder", second-package "recorder2"; each writes platform-<name>-output.json. A platform runs only when --platforms names it. A package that does not declare a named platform is warned about and not reported to it; a name no package declares fails the scan before it starts.

steps.name: --platforms=recorder
steps.note: Warns that second-package does not declare 'recorder'; first-package reports to it.

steps.name: --platforms=recorder,recorder2
steps.note: Two warnings (each package lacks the other platform); both platforms run at the same time.

steps.name: --platforms=unknown
steps.note: No package declares it: fails before scanning.
